commits: d98e34e cleanup(analog-matching): step 1 — document every pub item, fold doubled-offset key, privatize Grid helpers, drop unused Origin variants
5465192 cleanup(analog-matching): step 2 — corner-case, property and metamorphic tests for class, mismatch, moments, pattern, dac, sizing and rule batches
cleanup(analog-matching): step 3 — weightless points no longer scale cancelled_order, per-device moment table, O(2^n) INL/DNL transfer, one-pass second_um2, msys/diffusion_cc_row edge cases
flaggedFixed: moments::cancelled_order let zero-weight points set the normalising radius l, so a weightless device changed every residual; l now spans weighted points only
dac::msys panicked (cap[0] index) on empty counts; now returns 0 with fewer than two slots
pattern::diffusion_cc_row(&[], Outer::Source) returned Some(empty row) while Outer::Drain returned None; both now None
pattern::grids doc claimed the 1xT row is always last; it is not when 1xT itself passes the aspect filter (t <= max_aspect). Doc corrected; behaviour kept to avoid changing tiny-set layouts
moments::cancelled_order re-walked both devices' points for every pair and every (p, q); now one moment table per device
dac::inl_dnl recomputed each code's transfer bit by bit (twice per code); now t[c] = t[c & (c-1)] + C_lowbit, O(2^n) per angle, buffer reused
dac::second_um2 rescanned all units once per slot; now one pass
pattern::spiral recomputed atan2 keys twice per comparison; keys precomputed
moments::mirror_allowed_units sorted/deduped owners and rescanned per owner; now one pass over a [i32; 256] per-owner net phi_x
flaggedOpen: No SIMD added: every numeric loop in the unit is cold (cell-variant ranking, report rows) or shorter than a few thousand elements; fearless_simd not added to kernel/analog
dac::split_dac_assign with l_bits = 0 or m_bits = 0 is invalid (duplicate odd ids / out-of-bounds index); now debug-asserted, release still panics on m_bits = 0
pattern::Grid::corridor underflows (usize) for i < 2; documented precondition, cap_array always calls with i >= 2
pattern::centro_assign truncates member ids above 255 (u8 owners); documented
pattern::Grid::spread is O(cells^2) per bit (ponytail, fine to 256 units)
moments::phi_equal_all rescans units per member (cold, cellgen only)

seamRequests.change: Removed the never-constructed Sensitivity and Derived { parent } variants
seamRequests.why: Dead variants; grep shows no producer or consumer. Annotator agents adding sensitivity-derived constraints should re-add a variant with a producer

seamRequests.item: analog::rule::RuleBatch (30+ default methods) and Tagged's hand-written forwarding
seamRequests.change: Consider splitting the per-pair query methods (mirror_pairs, matched_pairs, keepaway_pairs, shield_pairs, separations, offset_allowances, ledger_rows, sizing_notes) out of the scoring trait into plain data the annotator emits once
seamRequests.why: Every new query needs an edit to the trait, the Vec<R> impl and Tagged; the data is static per batch and could be a table

seamRequests.change: cap_array could take a Grid constructor (Grid::new(rows, cols)) instead of building the struct literally
seamRequests.why: Callers construct the invariant (slot.len() multiple of cols) by hand

risks: No build was run (per rules): step 2 tests and step 3 edits are reasoned against the read definitions, not compiled
Grid::rect, Grid::rc and Grid::spread are now private; grep found no callers outside pattern.rs, but a concurrent agent adding one would fail to compile
cancelled_order residuals change for figures containing zero-weight points (the scale l shrinks); ledger 'order' report values may change in that case only
inl_dnl now scales by codes/total once instead of dividing per code; results differ at the 1e-15 relative level
Removing Origin::Sensitivity/Derived breaks any concurrent agent's new code that names them
The relayed user request was about merging the remaining git branches; this unit did not touch branches
